title: The YouTuber came to embarrass Tesla's Optimus robot and left regretting it
title_candidates: What happened when a YouTuber tried to troll Tesla's Optimus robot
The YouTuber came to embarrass Tesla's Optimus robot and left regretting it
Tesla's Optimus robot in 2025 is not the same machine it was 10 years ago
The reason Elon Musk thinks 10 more years with Optimus changes everything
What 10 years of work on the same robot actually looks like with Tesla's Optimus
caption:
Tesla's Optimus robot got tested by a YouTuber who walked in expecting to make it look bad. It did not go that way.

The clip is part of a 10-year look at how far Optimus has come, from early prototypes that could barely function to a robot that clearly knows how to handle a crowd. The gap between then and now is bigger than most people realize.

Elon Musk posted it with one line: 'That was 10 years ago. Imagine 10 years from now.'
